audit_stress_tests.target_criterion: A_new in (0.02, 0.95) & active grad > 1e-4 (vs raw min(A_new) == 1.0)

audit_stress_tests.target_criterion: Adaptive Boltzmann sharpens peak recovery over unscaled Boltzmann at large M
audit_stress_tests.details: M=6864: unscaled mean(A_new)=0.2322 -> log-M adaptive mean(A_new)=0.6565 (+0.4243)
